description: NetBird community-edition dashboard. Covers NetBird app metrics, optional Traefik edge metrics, and host metrics. Source: https://github.com/SunsetDrifter/netbird-grafana

panels.title: Services up
panels.description: UP only when every scraped NetBird component is healthy (Management, Signal, Relay). DOWN if any of them stops being scraped. Components you don't scrape are simply ignored.
Active peer streams currently connected to the management gRPC server.
panels.title: Connected peers

panels.description: Peers currently exchanging traffic through the relay.
panels.title: Relay peers (active)

panels.description: Idle relay peer slots — connected to the relay but no traffic flowing.
panels.title: Relay peers (idle)

panels.description: Open management proxy connections.
panels.title: Proxy connections

panels.description: Management server uptime since last process start.
panels.title: Uptime

panels.description: NetBird process restarts within the selected time range. Matches the restart annotation overlay; a nonzero value means a component restarted.
panels.title: Restarts

panels.description: Host CPU in use (100% − idle), averaged across cores.
panels.title: CPU %

panels.description: Host memory in use: (MemTotal − MemAvailable) / MemTotal.
panels.title: Memory %

panels.description: Host 1-minute load average. Compare against vCPU count.
panels.title: Load (1m)

panels.description: Connected gRPC peer streams over time.
panels.title: Connected peers over time

panels.description: Peers connected to the Signal service over time.
panels.title: Signal active peers over time

panels.description: Relay peers: total connected, actively transferring, and idle.
panels.title: Relay peers (total / active / idle)

panels.description: HTTP request rate per management API endpoint.
panels.title: HTTP request rate by endpoint

panels.description: HTTP responses by status code.
panels.title: HTTP response codes
HTTP error rate (5xx + auth fails)
panels.description: Rate of HTTP 5xx + 401/403 responses from the management API.
Management API request latency (p50, p90, p99) across all endpoints.
panels.title: HTTP request latency (p50/p90/p99)
Slowest endpoints (p99 last 5m)
panels.description: Per-endpoint p99 latency over the last 5 minutes. Sort by Latency desc to find offenders.
gRPC Sync calls/sec — peers polling for network-map updates. The core peer heartbeat.
panels.title: Sync request rate

panels.description: Latency of gRPC Sync calls. Rising p99 means peers wait longer for network-map updates.
panels.title: Sync request latency (p50/p90/p99)

panels.description: gRPC Login calls/sec — peers (re)authenticating to management.
panels.title: Login request rate

panels.description: Latency of gRPC Login calls (includes IdP round-trips).
panels.title: Login request latency (p50/p90/p99)

panels.description: gRPC GetServerKey calls/sec — issued by peers during initial handshake.
panels.title: GetServerKey request rate

panels.description: Signal messages forwarded/sec between peers (connection-negotiation traffic).
panels.title: Message forward rate

panels.description: Failed Signal message forwards/sec. Should sit at zero; spikes break peer negotiation.
panels.title: Message forward failures

panels.description: Latency forwarding a Signal message between peers.
panels.title: Message forward latency (p50/p90/p99)

panels.description: Peers registering and deregistering with Signal per second.
panels.title: Registration / deregistration rate

panels.description: Failed Signal registrations/sec. Should be zero.
panels.title: Registration failures

panels.description: Time for a peer to register with the Signal service.
panels.title: Registration latency (p50/p90/p99)

panels.description: How long peers stay connected to Signal. Short durations across the board can indicate churn or network instability.
panels.title: Peer connection duration (p50/p90/p99)

panels.description: Latency of Signal get_registration lookups (peers resolving where to reach a peer).
panels.title: get_registration latency (p50/p90/p99)

panels.description: Signal gRPC RPCs/sec by method (Send, ConnectStream) from the otelgrpc server instrumentation.
panels.title: gRPC request rate (by method)

panels.description: p99 latency of Signal gRPC calls by method (otelgrpc server instrumentation).
panels.title: gRPC request latency p99 (by method)

panels.description: Bytes/sec relayed on behalf of peers that cannot connect directly (rx positive, tx negative).
panels.title: Relay traffic bandwidth

panels.description: Time to authenticate a peer joining the relay.
panels.title: Relay peer authentication latency (p50/p90/p99)

panels.description: Relay internal peer-store operation latency.
panels.title: Relay peer store latency (p50/p90/p99)
Store transaction latency (p50/p90/p99)
panels.description: Time to execute a single store transaction. Backend-agnostic (SQLite or PostgreSQL); watch p99 for DB contention as the deployment grows.

panels.title: Store transaction rate
panels.description: Transactions/sec against the store (SQLite or PostgreSQL). Sudden spikes correlate with bulk config changes or peer-storm conditions.
Time to acquire the management global account lock. Sustained growth signals write contention. Typically near-zero on PostgreSQL; more significant on single-writer SQLite.
panels.title: Global lock acquisition duration (p50/p90/p99)

panels.description: Time to persist a change to the store backend (the write/flush step, separate from the surrounding transaction). Backend-agnostic.
panels.title: Store persistence latency (p50/p90/p99)
Account-update notifications by resource × operation
panels.description: Which kinds of config changes are notifying peers. Useful for spotting test workloads that cause excessive peer churn.
p99 time to build a peer's network map (GetPeerNetworkMap). Grows with account/peer count.
panels.title: Network-map build latency (p99)

panels.description: p99 time to push updates to all account peers (UpdateAccountPeers). High values delay config propagation.
panels.title: Peer-update fan-out latency (p99)

panels.description: p99 depth of the per-peer update queue. Sustained growth means peers consume updates slower than produced.
panels.title: Update-channel queue length (p99)

panels.description: Number of objects in peers' network maps. Grows with account size (peers, groups, policies, routes); large maps mean bigger sync payloads and longer build times.
panels.title: Network-map size (objects, p50/p90/p99)

panels.description: Identity-provider call rate by operation. get_accounts = list-all (account sync); get_account = single lookup; authenticate = token validation; update_user_meta = profile writes.
panels.title: IdP request rates (by operation)
PAT usage distribution
panels.description: Counts of Personal Access Token uses. The histogram's `_count` total rises with API calls authenticated via PATs.

panels.title: Proxy connections over time
panels.description: Active connections through the OSS reverse proxy.

panels.title: Proxy heartbeats per second
panels.description: Rate of heartbeats received from configured proxy peers.

panels.title: Request rate by router
panels.description: HTTP requests/sec at Traefik, grouped by router (gRPC vs API vs OAuth2 vs dashboard).

panels.title: Router p99 latency
panels.description: P99 latency observed at the Traefik router layer (includes time in the backend service).

panels.title: Router 4xx/5xx rate
panels.description: HTTP error rate per router. Distinguishes app errors from auth challenges depending on which router serves them.

panels.title: Open connections by entrypoint
panels.description: Current open connections at each Traefik entrypoint (web/websecure/metrics).

panels.title: CPU usage %
panels.description: Percent of CPU time NOT idle, averaged across cores. 50% on a 2-vCPU box ≈ one core fully busy.

panels.title: Memory used %
panels.description: (MemTotal - MemAvailable) / MemTotal. MemAvailable accounts for reclaimable cache.

panels.title: Load average
panels.description: 1m / 5m / 15m load. Stays well below NumCPU when healthy (here, 2).

panels.title: Network throughput
panels.description: Host-level NIC bytes/s, excluding loopback. Receive negative, transmit positive.
CPU usage of the netbird-server process (%).
panels.title: CPU

panels.description: Resident memory of the netbird-server process.
panels.title: Memory (RSS)

panels.description: Open file descriptors.
panels.title: File descriptors

panels.description: Network bytes in / out (transmit shown negative).
panels.title: Network I/O
Goroutines
panels.description: Unbounded growth indicates a leak.

panels.title: GC pause (p99)
panels.description: P99 of stop-the-world GC pause duration.

panels.title: Heap in use
panels.description: Bytes currently allocated on the Go heap.
